transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well, I came in because... my husband and the people down at the warehouse keep acting like I'm crazy. But I know what's going on. They've been watching my moves. They actually keep changing the pallet counts on my shifts just to keep me from getting that supervisor spot.
Do you ever hear voices when no one is there?

Yeah, I do. Sometimes when I'm out in the aisle at work, or even just at home folding clothes, I hear a man's voice. It's clear as day. He tells me, Nicole, check it again. But whenever I look around, there is nobody anywhere near me.
Have there been times when you felt unusually energized and needed much less sleep than usual?

Yeah, actually. There have been weeks where I sleep... maybe three hours a night. I'll just wake up way before my alarm even goes off, and I feel completely fine. Like I don't need any more rest at all to just get moving and start my day.
During those times when you slept only a few hours, did you feel unusually happy or high?

Well, it's kind of a mix. Some days I feel... fired up, you know? Like nobody can slow me down and I'm just on top of everything. But then, if my husband asks even one small question—like about the kids or what my schedule is for the day—I just snap. I get so irritable because it feels like he's trying to control me when I'm just trying to get things done.
During those times, did you feel unusually euphoric or on top of the world?

Yeah, like I was just saying, it's exactly like that. I feel completely fired up, like I'm on top of the world and nobody can slow me down. But it doesn't always stay as a good feeling. Like I mentioned, it turns into anger really fast. If my husband asks me even one small question about the kids or what my schedule is, I just snap at him. It just feels like he's trying to control me when I'm in that zone.
Have you ever heard that man's voice during a time when your mood felt normal—not especially high, energized, or irritable?

Yeah, I have. There was a stretch... a quieter few weeks, I guess, where I was sleeping closer to normal and I wasn't racing around like I get sometimes. But I still heard him. The voice was still there telling me to check things, and I still knew that the pallet counts at work were being changed against me. Even when my mood was fine, that didn't stop.
Have you had times when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?

No, I haven't really had that. I mean... I don't really get sad or down like that. Usually, it's just the being fired up or the angry stuff I told you about. But I haven't felt depressed for weeks at a time, no.
Have the voice and the belief that people are changing the pallet counts been going on for more than one month?
Yeah, definitely longer than a month. Um, I'd say the voice and that feeling that people are watching me or changing the counts... it's been happening for about eight months now.
Was there ever a period of at least two weeks when the voice and your belief about the pallet counts were happening while your mood was completely normal?

Yeah, like I was saying a minute ago, there was that quieter stretch. It was definitely a few weeks—more than two, for sure. I was sleeping closer to normal and I wasn't racing around all wired. But even during that time, I still heard the voice telling me to check things. And I still knew they were messing with the pallet counts against me at work. So yeah, even when my mood was totally fine for those weeks, all of that was still happening.
